blocks.text: Your Go-To Guide for Beauty and Confidence
How to Prepare for Your Microblading Consultation

A successful consultation begins with discussing your brow goals, lifestyle, and past experiences. Bring photos showing preferred shapes, and share any medical concerns. Your artist assesses your skin and natural brows, offering personalized recommendations tailored.
The Difference Between Microblading and Powder Brows

Microblading uses delicate hair strokes for a natural look, while powder brows create a soft, shaded finish. Each technique suits different skin types and style preferences. Understanding both options helps you choose the approach that best complements your features.
How to Maintain Your Brows Between Touch-Ups

Keeping your brows fresh between touch-up sessions requires gentle daily care. Avoid over-exfoliating the forehead, protect the area from direct sun, and moisturize lightly. Steering clear of harsh ingredients helps maintain pigment clarity and ensures your brows stay polished.
How to Choose the Perfect Brow Shape for Your Face

Selecting the right brow shape enhances facial balance and highlights your features beautifully. Consider your bone structure, natural hair growth, and desired expression. A trained artist maps your brows precisely, creating a design that fits your face.
Top Reasons Microblading Fades Too Quickly

If your microblading fades faster than expected, lifestyle habits or skincare products are often responsible. Excessive sun exposure, exfoliating acids, and heavy sweating can accelerate fading. Following proper aftercare and maintaining gentle skincare helps preserve pigment.
Microblading Healing Stages: What to Expect Day by Day

Understanding the normal healing stages helps reduce stress during recovery. Expect mild redness initially, followed by temporary darkening and flaking. Allow the pigment to settle naturally. Avoid sun exposure, sweating, and harsh skincare to protect your results
Are You a Good Candidate for Microblading?

Determining candidacy depends on your skin type, medical history, and beauty goals. Oily skin or certain conditions may affect pigment retention. A consultation allows your artist to evaluate your brows, discuss expectations, and recommend the safest approach.
How to Prepare for Your Microblading Appointment

To prepare for a microblading appointment, avoid sun exposure, alcohol, caffeine, and blood-thinning medications like aspirin and ibuprofen for 48 hours beforehand. Avoid waxing or tinting your brows for a week , and stop using retinoids or chemical peels...

Katelyn is a precision-based PMU artist with over 7 years of hands-on experience in microblading and natural beauty transformations. Clients trust her not just for her technical skill, but for the calm, grounding energy she brings into every session. Her work is defined by clean technique, subtle enhancement, and lasting results that honor each client’s natural beauty.

Licensed Esthetician

Advanced training in nano-strokes

PMU (Permanent Makeup) removal is a non-invasive treatment that lifts and extracts unwanted pigment from the skin using a saline or non-laser technique.
How many sessions will I need?
It varies depending on the depth, age, and color of the pigment. Most clients need between 2–5 sessions for optimal results.
Most clients report only mild discomfort. We use a numbing agent to ensure your experience is as comfortable as possible.
What should I avoid before my appointment?
Avoid blood thinners (like caffeine, aspirin, alcohol) 24 hours before your session. Come with no makeup on the treated area.
Can you remove old or botched microblading?
Yes! We specialize in lifting and correcting old or poorly done brow tattoos, microblading, and other PMU services.
Is this better than laser removal?
Our non-laser technique is gentler on the skin and specifically designed for delicate facial areas like brows, with less risk of scarring or color distortion.
How do I book and is a deposit required?
A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to secure your appointment. You can book through the Vagaro app, click any “Book Now” link on our site, or text us directly at (559) 466-8233.

Your lashes are gently shaped around a silicone shield and treated with a lifting solution to create a long-lasting curl. This process lifts each lash individually, making them appear longer, darker, and more voluminous. The treatment is safe, comfortable, and suitable for most lash types.

A lash lift typically lasts 6–8 weeks, depending on your natural lash cycle. You can wear mascara, wash your face, and maintain your normal routine after the first 24 hours. No refills or upkeep are required—just beautifully lifted lashes every day.

blocks.text: Brow lamination is a semi-permanent treatment that smooths, lifts, and shapes the natural brow hairs into a fuller, more defined look. It creates a soft, fluffy finish that lasts for weeks, giving you effortlessly polished brows without daily styling.

During the treatment, a gentle lifting solution softens the hair bonds, allowing the brows to be shaped into your desired direction. The hairs are then set in place with a neutralizing formula, creating a lifted, uniform, and fuller appearance that flatters your facial features.

Brow lamination is ideal for those with uneven, sparse, or unruly brows. The treatment enhances natural volume, improves symmetry, and provides a sleek, brushed-up look that stays in place. Results typically last 6–8 weeks with minimal maintenance.

seo.og:title: Methods of Teeth Whitening | Ktln Studio
seo.twitter:title: Methods of Teeth Whitening | Ktln Studio

blocks.text: Teeth whitening is a popular cosmetic procedure that uses bleaching agents to lighten the color of natural teeth and remove stains. The primary active ingredients are typically hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide, which break down stain molecules in the enamel and dentin

This is the fastest and most effective method, performed by a dentist in a single or a few visits (e.g., Zoom whitening or laser whitening). The dentist applies a high-concentration peroxide gel (15% to 43%) and often uses a special light or heat to accelerate the process. This method provides immediate, dramatic results, often several shades lighter.

Before starting any whitening treatment, it is essential to have an oral examination to ensure your teeth and gums are healthy enough. Whitening is not suitable for individuals with gum disease, cavities, or exposed tooth roots.

seo.twitter:title: What to Expect During Microblading | Ktln Studio

blocks.text: Microblading is a detailed, semi-permanent technique that uses fine, hair-like strokes to create naturally fuller brows. It’s perfect for clients who want subtle definition, improved shape, and long-lasting enhancement that looks soft and realistic.

Your artist begins by mapping your brows using precise measurements to ensure symmetry and balance. After selecting a pigment shade that matches your natural hair, fine strokes are implanted into the skin to replicate real brow hairs. The process is safe, meticulous, and customized to your features

Proper aftercare helps your results heal beautifully. Avoid sweating, heavy workouts, and moisture on the brow area for the first few days. Mild fading, flaking, and darkening are normal during the healing process. A touch-up session enhances color and ensures long-lasting definition.
